title: Which Came First? Omniscient Reader's Viewpoint From Novel to Film
description: Ten rounds of four releases and milestones where you pick the earliest or the latest: web novel, webtoon, English editions, the live-action film and the end of season one. No story spoilers.
notes: First format: each question gives four release milestones; every date comes from a verified fact, and the answer is the earliest or the latest of the four.
